values.note: $8 per night per site (FS page; recreation.gov 2026 and 2027 peak seasons alike). Federal recreation passes accepted. Columbus Day to May 15 the FS lists no services, no reservations and no fees.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/little-bass-lake-campsites ('Camping fee is $8 per night per site. Federal Recreation Passes (Golden/America the Beautiful) are accepted.' 'No services/no reservations/no fees after that time Columbus Day through May 15.'; last updated March 20, 2025) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273349/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-15 and 2027-05-15 to 2027-10-15: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 8), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Five back-in sites: 002-005 take vehicles to 24 ft (a 23-ft motorhome fits with little to spare), 001 only 20 ft. Up to 8 people per site.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for 273349 (5 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, all reservable, Driveway Entry Back-In; Max Vehicle Length 24 on 002, 003, 004, 005 and 20 on 001) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273349 ('Number of Sites: 5 Maximum Number of People Per Site: 8'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No drinking water. Pack in, pack out. recreation.gov says 'There is a primitive toilet located at this site'; the FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site'. Carry-in boat launch.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273349 ('There is NO drinking water at this site. There is a primitive toilet located at this site.' 'Boat Access: Carry - In'; notice 'Pack-In, Pack-out policy') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/little-bass-lake-campsites ('Restrooms are not available at this site.' 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservation only from May 15 through Columbus Day: 'Walk ins are not allowed.' The site must be occupied the first night and may not be left unattended more than 24 hours. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. The recreation.gov peak season runs May 15 - October 15 (2026, 2027).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/little-bass-lake-campsites ('Camping at Littel Bass Lake is by reservation only. Walk ins are not allowed. These sites may be reserved for up to 14 days.' 'Reservations through Columbus Day.' 'Seasons of Use May 15 - Columbus Day'; check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273349 (notices 'There is a 14-day stay limit.', 'Campsite must be occupied the first night.', 'Campsite cannot be left unattended for more than 24 hours.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273349/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-10-15), read 2026-10-25

note: Five rustic campsites on 84-acre Little Bass Lake, Hiawatha NF, 22 mi north of Manistique via M-94, CR 437 and forest roads 2213/2639; carry-in launch, swimming, bass/pike/perch fishing, berry picking, horse, bike and hiking trails nearby. Sites 004 and 005 are the lakeside ones. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated March 2025) + recreation.gov + RIDB: $8 (confirmed), 5 sites (confirmed), max 24 ft (confirmed; 002-005 at 24 ft fit EKKO, 001 at 20 ft does not), all back-in (new), no drinking water (confirmed), reservable on recreation.gov (confirmed), reservation only/no walk-ins (fcfs never, new), 14-day limit (new), reservation season May 15 - Columbus Day (booking.season new). FS operated (recreation.gov org FS, not commercially managed). Season not written: the FS 'Seasons of Use May 15 - Columbus Day' is paired with 'no services/no reservations/no fees' off season, so it reads as the fee season rather than a closure.
